nodes.label: Protect the Student's Own Construction Work (guardrail principle)
nodes.rationale: Justin Sung / HUDLE-derived principle: the AI must decline requests to build a student a standalone, save-able study artifact (mind map, study guide, notes, summary) because the act of organizing/connecting ideas is where encoding into memory happens; handing over a finished artifact skips that step. Normal teaching (explaining, connecting ideas in prose, extending the student's own active mental model) remains fine. Drafted but not yet wired into tutor_service.php as of this test harness; validated here via hand-authored compliant transcripts run through the real formatResponse()+tm-widgets.js rendering pipeline.
nodes.norm_label: protect the student's own construction work (guardrail principle)

nodes.label: Active Mental Model Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Existing mechanism the new construction-ownership guardrail must reconcile with: a tm-steps worked example inside an active mental model demonstrates only ONE case and must be followed by a tm-task that asks the student to extend the model to a new facet in their own words, rather than the AI walking through further cases itself.

nodes.label: 2026-07-27 onboarding Continue-button incident
nodes.rationale: A JS bundle called document.getElementById() for an id that didn't exist yet in the PHP page that loaded it; both files were syntactically valid so php -l / node --check missed it. ci-check-dom-ids.js was built specifically to catch this class of cross-file id mismatch via a non-blocking static regex scan of known page/script pairs.

nodes.label: Power outage during mobile redesign implementation
nodes.rationale: The mobile-first redesign (bottom nav, mobile profile sheet, mobile.css, isMobile()/setupBottomNav() in chat-interface.js, disabling old 768px blocks in ui-overhaul.css via a dead @media(max-width:0px) block) was only partially implemented before a power outage interrupted work, leaving the interface mangled. 13 subsequent fixes restored structural CSS, specificity wins, and animation states that had been left inside the dead media-query block.
nodes.norm_label: power outage during mobile redesign implementation

nodes.label: Fix 1: History tray missing structural CSS
nodes.rationale: position:fixed/transform:translateY(100%) for .mobile-history-tray was stuck in the disabled 0px media block; without it the tray flowed as a flex item next to .main-chat-wrapper instead of sliding up as a sheet.
nodes.norm_label: fix 1: history tray missing structural css

nodes.label: Fix 2: Overlay pointer-events blocked close-on-tap
nodes.rationale: Global .sidebar-overlay.active had pointer-events:none; fixed via higher-specificity ID selector #mobile-sidebar-overlay.active { pointer-events:auto }.

nodes.label: Fix 3: Desktop sidebar showing on mobile (CSS specificity)
nodes.rationale: aside#sidebar.sidebar {display:flex!important} in ui-overhaul.css (element+ID+class specificity) beat the single-class .desktop-only{display:none!important} rule; fixed by matching specificity in mobile.css loaded after ui-overhaul.css.
nodes.norm_label: fix 3: desktop sidebar showing on mobile (css specificity)

nodes.label: Fix 4: Input bar offset/centered incorrectly on mobile
nodes.rationale: Desktop's 300px sidebar-offset left value and empty-chat vertical centering leaked onto mobile where the sidebar is hidden, misplacing the input bar; fixed with a combined selector forcing left:0/bottom pinned above the bottom nav.
nodes.norm_label: fix 4: input bar offset/centered incorrectly on mobile

nodes.label: Fix 12: Bottom nav premium redesign (frosted glass, pill indicator)
nodes.rationale: iOS-style frosted glass bottom nav with backdrop-filter blur/saturate, pill-shaped active indicator behind the icon only, equal flex column spacing, and a plain-color brand logo; backdrop-filter's stacking context clipped earlier attempts to raise the logo above the nav, resolved by keeping the brand within nav bounds.
nodes.norm_label: fix 12: bottom nav premium redesign (frosted glass, pill indicator)

nodes.label: Fix 13: api/user_settings.php 500 errors investigation (no-op)
nodes.rationale: Pulse monitor showed historical 500s on /api/user_settings.php; investigation found the legibility column present and no current fatal errors — the errors were stale/aged-out data from before the session, so no code change was required.

nodes.label: Distinctive Frontend Design Principle (Avoid AI-Slop Aesthetics)
nodes.rationale: Guidance to commit to a bold, intentional aesthetic direction (typography, color, motion, spatial composition) and explicitly avoid generic AI-generated patterns: overused fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial, Space Grotesk), purple-gradient-on-white color schemes, and predictable cookie-cutter layouts.
nodes.norm_label: distinctive frontend design principle (avoid ai-slop aesthetics)

nodes.label: Three-Contact Protocol
nodes.rationale: Neuroscience-backed learning architecture: student must make Analogy (schema activation), Build (enactment encoding), and Predict (generation effect) contacts per concept before the AI advances. Installed invisibly in the system prompt via detectContactState()/buildSystemPrompt() so tutoring feels normal but drives active encoding rather than passive answer-consumption.

nodes.label: Modern Scholar Design System
nodes.rationale: Neo-brutalist aesthetic (thick 2-3px borders, 4-6px hard offset shadows, sharp 4px corners, Playfair Display headings + Inter body) applied across chat and onboarding; later found to co-exist unresolved with a purple-gradient/glass system on .main-chat-wrapper in light mode only.

nodes.label: Debug Log Exposure & Server-Side Error Sanitization
nodes.rationale: Audit found DEBUG_MODE hardcoded true in includes/server_mysql.php, writing $_FILES and raw student messages to a publicly-reachable, unprotected includes/debug_log.txt (104KB/3322 lines, months old). Set DEBUG_MODE=false, deleted the file, added an .htaccess deny rule for .log/.txt, and swept ~9 endpoints that were echoing raw $e->getMessage() to clients, replacing with generic messages + server-side error_log().
nodes.norm_label: debug log exposure & server-side error sanitization

nodes.label: MarkItDown Document Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Replaced PHP-native PDF/DOCX/PPTX parsers with a Python CLI (MarkItDown) shelled out via markitdown_extract.py to avoid PHP memory-limit blowups on large PPTX; later partially reversed (PDF: pure-PHP smalot/pdfparser tried first) once memory wasn't the bottleneck. Also underlies the YouTube transcript pipeline, rewritten four times in one day chasing shared-hosting exec()/Python constraints before settling on youtube-transcript-api hitting the timedtext endpoint directly.

nodes.label: CI/CD Pipeline (dev branch auto-deploy)
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions on push to dev (confirmed as the real production branch) runs php -l, node --check, and a custom DOM-id cross-check (scripts/ci-check-dom-ids.js) designed to catch the exact bug class of a JS file referencing a getElementById() id missing from its paired PHP page. Passing checks gate an SSH hard-reset deploy so the live tree can't end up desynced. Needs manually-added GitHub secrets and a deploy SSH key — not achievable from the dev environment.

nodes.label: Interactive Widgets (tm-* fenced blocks)
nodes.rationale: Brilliant-style tappable in-chat widgets (tm-check/tm-chips/tm-hints/tm-steps/tm-task/tm-order/tm-cloze) replacing plain-text Socratic prose. Getting the model to reliably choose widgets over prose, avoid supplying its own analogy first, and not leak widget machinery to the student required few-shot examples rather than described rules — co-locating a rule with its worked example beat a purely descriptive instruction.

nodes.label: Construction-Ownership Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Justin Sung/HUDLE-grounded rule: the AI must not auto-generate mind maps, study guides, summaries, or relationship comparisons on the student's behalf, since manual construction is where encoding happens. Broadened from matching only artifact nouns to matching the underlying act of organizing relationships conversationally. Fixed a case where the redirect rendered as bare prose because the rule and its worked example sat ~30KB apart in the prompt, letting a rhetorically-similar SCOPE BOUNDARIES decline pattern win the cascade instead.

nodes.label: server_mysql.php Modularization into api/services/*
nodes.rationale: Procedural require_once split (no OOP, low-risk) of the ~2,938-line monolithic server_mysql.php into document_service.php, ai_service.php, response_formatter.php, comprehension_service.php, and tutor_service.php, reducing the main file by 55% to ~1,324 lines while preserving behavior (php -l verified at each step).

nodes.label: Pomodoro Timer + Active Recall Quiz
nodes.rationale: Pomodoro study timer auto-triggers an AI-graded active recall quiz (api/quiz.php) adapted to difficulty mode (gentle/standard/challenge) when the session ends. Later gated on Three-Contact state rather than the comprehension score, since comprehension score is a noisy, cumulative, neutral-starting signal that a silently confused student never moves.

nodes.label: RAG Automation & Topic Tagging
nodes.rationale: Fixed RAG only ever serving cached knowledge_base content: after an empty retrieveRelevant() call, searchAndStore() now proactively seeds the KB from a live SerpAPI search and retries within the same request, so the very first mention of a topic benefits from retrieval instead of only subsequent conversations.

nodes.label: AI Provider Fallback Chain (Gemini -> Groq -> DeepSeek)
nodes.rationale: Gemini free tier's 20 RPD limit made it impractical alone; Groq (14,400 RPD, llama-3.3-70b-versatile) activated as primary fallback once its API key was populated. Fallback trigger widened from rate-limit-style errors (429/500/503) to also cover auth/invalid-key errors (400) so an expired GEMINI_API_KEY degrades gracefully instead of hard-failing.
nodes.norm_label: ai provider fallback chain (gemini -> groq -> deepseek)

nodes.label: Quiz Gate: Skip Assessment on Missing Contacts
nodes.rationale: handleGenerate() in api/quiz.php returns not_ready:true when 2+ of the three Three-Contact states are missing, and the frontend shows an encouraging nudge instead of the quiz modal. Chosen over gating on comprehension score because that score starts neutral, drifts only on explicit signals, and is cumulative across the session so early resolved confusion still drags it down at quiz time.
nodes.norm_label: quiz gate: skip assessment on missing contacts

nodes.label: Imunify360 WAF Code-Snippet Blocking Workaround
nodes.rationale: Production Namecheap host runs Imunify360 WAF (not configurable from cPanel) that pattern-matched code syntax like {}, function(), return() in POST bodies as injection attacks, causing 403s. Fixed by base64-encoding the question field client-side before sending and decoding server-side, so the WAF sees an opaque string instead of code patterns. Fragile: would break if Imunify360 starts decoding base64 before scanning; permanent fix requires a hosting-support whitelist.

nodes.label: Chat Redesign: Flat ChatGPT-Style Bubbles + Input Bar
nodes.rationale: Simplified the chat UI from bordered/sticker-shadow message cards and a cluttered multi-row input bar into a flat layout: plain-text AI turns, filled-pill user turns, avatars hidden, and Tools menu + Bloom's-level picker collapsed into a single '+' panel. Reviewed first as a standalone Artifact mockup before touching the live app. Had to out-cascade a pre-existing !important neo-brutalist layer forcing thick borders/shadows onto the send and voice-mode buttons.
nodes.norm_label: chat redesign: flat chatgpt-style bubbles + input bar

nodes.label: User Name Atomization (full_name -> first_name/last_name)
nodes.rationale: 1NF-compliant database normalization splitting the users.full_name column into first_name/last_name, enabling last-name sorting, first-name-only greetings, and more flexible querying; full_name retained post-migration for rollback safety.

nodes.label: 404 Page Not Found Illustration (Disconnected Brain-Bot Mascot)
nodes.description: 3D-rendered cute robot mascot with a translucent dome head revealing a glowing blue/purple neural-network 'brain', unplugging/holding a disconnected power cord. '404 PAGE NOT FOUND' text repeated twice diagonally in light lavender on a soft white/lavender background. The unplugged cord visually represents a broken connection ('page not found'), while the exposed glowing brain ties the mascot to TutorMind's brain/mind branding. Style: soft pastel 3D character illustration, friendly/approachable tone typical of SaaS error-state art.

nodes.label: TutorMind Bridge Logo (SVG)
nodes.description: 40x40 SVG mark: a rounded-arch curve rendered in the purple brand gradient (#5E2EBF to #9D6BF5), evoking a bridge span. An amber/orange dot (#F59E0B) caps the arch's apex as a 'connection point', while two purple dots anchor the arch's base as 'grounding points'. The bridge motif visually encodes TutorMind's core metaphor of connecting/bridging a learner to understanding.
